note: psp.cz stenographic records; tools/data/priorities/ is not committed. Where the zip archive answers 404 (all of 2002ps, the latest 2025ps sittings), sittings ending in 2004 or later were fetched page by page and packed into a zip with fixed timestamps; their hash is of that zip. Where an archive's day files disagree with the days of the zip index (stale day files, e.g. 2017ps sittings carrying 2021ps day pages), the day files served online are packed into <sitting>-days.zip and used instead.
